_note: Example Stupp-protocol run manifest. All numeric values are PLACEHOLDERS - review before scientific use.
_clock: All times are days on the solver clock: t=0 is the tumor seed, so the simulated growth time before surgery is resection.time itself; the run ends at resection.time + solver.time_after_resection (alternatively give solver.stopping_time, the total horizon from the seed).
_schedule: seed (day 0) --100 days growth--> resection (day 100) --recovery--> RT 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks, days 114-153 (Mon = day 114, 2 weeks post-op), concomitant TMZ on the same 30 days (simplified: TMZ is given daily in the real protocol) --> follow-up growth to day 200.
_paths: NIfTI paths are absolute or relative to this file. The 'tissue' and 'solver' sections are optional; explicit CLI arguments of scripts/run_stupp_forward.py override them.
_parameter_ranges: rho, white_matter_diffusivity and diffusivity_ratio are the means of scripts/parameter_range.txt (previous inverse runs; diffusivity_ratio = 10^mean(log10 ratio)). Not solver parameters, recorded for reference only: th_up 0.59795, th_down 0.29291 (segmentation thresholds), pet_bkg_lvl 0.3.

solver._units: rho in 1/day, white_matter_diffusivity in mm^2/day, times in days; the horizon is set by exactly one of time_after_resection or stopping_time; the time step by exactly one of steps_per_day, dt (days) or n_steps (steps_per_day / dt are translated to n_steps = ceil(stopping_time / dt)); none of them selects the stability formula. Any other scalar StuppFKPPSolver parameter may be set here under its solver name (e.g. gaussian_seed_mass, min_tissue_fraction, stopping_threshold).

chemotherapy._units: kill_rate in 1/day per unit concentration, decay_rate in 1/day; each session deposits a unit concentration.

radiotherapy._units: dose NIfTI in Gy, TOTAL over all fractions (per-fraction dose = dose / len(times)); alpha in 1/Gy, beta in 1/Gy^2.
